decisions.reason: LLM choice provides exchange rates, not central bank interest rates; semantic top-1 is more aligned with currency data needed.
LLM choice API provides bank data including central bank flags, directly relevant to identifying top central banks.
LLM choice API allows querying banks by country including central banks, suitable for retrieving interest rates of top central banks.
LLM choice API provides bank lists with central/non-central flags, fitting the need to fetch non-central bank interest rates.
No API explicitly supports report compilation; semantic top-1 is acceptable as no better alternative.
